visual_text: Easing a dry mouth in the last days of life
Sips of drink, if they want them
Family can help, if they wish
Ask the nurse to show you how to do it safely
Fluids by drip or under the skin are a separate decision, made for each person.
NICE NG31, 2015; McCann et al., JAMA 1994 (32 people, cancer)
alt_text: Illustration of a son sitting beside his mother's bed, leaning in to moisten her lips; she rests propped on pillows. A glass sits on the bedside table. Checklist: sips of drink if wanted, frequent mouth and lip care, ice chips or moistened lips, family can help, ask the nurse to show you. Drips are a separate decision.
design_instructions: Sand card. Kit scene: older woman propped in domestic bed, adult son seated leaning in, glass on bedside table, window; badge 'Illustration, not a real person'. Mint panel with five tick items; small note on drips. Sources NICE NG31 and McCann 1994.
